scene.placeText: a glass-furnace workshop on the glass island of her steam city at dusk — the round mouth of the furnace glowing amber, brass blowpipes in racks, a great half-finished chandelier of coloured glass hanging from a brass hoist, and through the arched doorway the lagoon and the gaslit palaces across the water
scene.ownProp: a long brass blowpipe tipped with a glowing glass flower of cobalt and ruby
scene.outfit: a glassmaker look fitted to her body — a short honey-brown leather work apron over a fitted sleeveless bodice fastened with millefiori glass studs, high-waisted short bloomers, a brass tool harness, one big brass gauntlet glove, earrings like tiny glass chandeliers and laced ankle boots
scene.scene: she is the chandelier glassmaker of the island, lifting a freshly blown glass flower on the end of her brass pipe toward the gaslight to check its cobalt and ruby colours before it joins the chandelier
